Source Monster

Monster: Monoblos | CR: 12 | Tier: 3

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

Whenever you have @variantrule[Advantage|XPHB] on a melee attack roll with this weapon and hit, you can knock the target @condition[prone] if the lower of the two d20 rolls would also hit the target.

Armor Effect

You have resistance to cold damage while you wear this armor.

Tags: weapon-type:melee, mechanic:advantage, mechanic:condition, type:offensive, mechanic:resistance, damage:cold, type:defensive
